AgentAssessment.description:
The agent's written record of one supervision turn.

This is deliberately not how the agent acts: acting is a
[`PrintAction`](crate::PrintAction) that policy rules on.

escalating.description: Whether the agent is escalating to a person.

should_continue.description: Whether the print should carry on.

summary.description: One line saying what is happening.

Confidence.description:
How sure the agent is.

A closed vocabulary rather than a number, because a number invites a
precision the agent does not have.

PrintId.description: A lowercase hyphenated version 7 UUID identifying one print.
PrintId.title: PrintId

SessionPhase.description: Whether a turn opened a session or continued one.

oneOf.description: This turn continued a session already open.

SupervisionSession.description: The supervision session keyed to one print.

close_reason.description: Why it was closed, if it was.

closed_at.description: When the session was closed, if it was.

harness_identity.description: The identity the harness ran the session under.

session_name.description: The session's own name in the harness.

Timestamp.description: An instant in UTC, as an RFC 3339 string with a zero offset.
Timestamp.title: Timestamp

description: What one supervision turn answered with.

assessment.description: The agent's written record of the turn.

phase.description: Whether this turn opened that session or continued it.

session.description: The session the turn ran in.
